utterance: Hi Carly, how are you doing today?

But sometimes, when you read this thread or see the way you're feeling, it seems real and very much inside your body.

The fear that it *is* something serious, like a brain tumor, keeps lurking in the back of your mind every time you feel dizzy or lose that sense of all-encompassing awareness.
